title: 6 jobs to finish before the first freeze.

slides.label: Property care
slides.title: 6 jobs to finish before the first freeze.
slides.body: Comment ESTATE for the property file checklist.

slides.label: 01 · Outdoor water
slides.title: Shut off and drain outdoor faucets.
slides.body: Disconnect hoses and drain irrigation lines so pipes don't freeze and split.

slides.label: 02 · Gutters
slides.title: Clear gutters and downspouts.
slides.body: When they're blocked, melting snow and rain have nowhere to go.

slides.label: 03 · Heating
slides.title: Get the heating serviced.
slides.body: Book the HVAC vendor now, before the first cold snap fills their calendar.

slides.label: 04 · Detectors
slides.title: Test smoke and CO detectors.
slides.body: Fresh batteries, a test on every floor, and the date written down.

slides.label: 05 · Drafts
slides.title: Seal drafts at doors and windows.
slides.body: Weatherstripping and caulk are cheap. Heat leaking out all winter isn't.

slides.label: 06 · Snow plan
slides.title: Line up snow removal.
slides.body: Agree on the vendor, the rate and when they show up before the first storm.
slides.you: Who calls whom, and at how many inches.

slides.label: The record
slides.title: Log every job in the file

caption:
6 jobs to finish before the first hard freeze. Comment ESTATE and we'll DM you the checklist we use to set up every property file.
